name: Status ring
description: Shows the battery, network and volume in one ring open at the bottom, after the design of DuoBar (github.com/Mikeli7666/DuoBar). Its popup has cards for Wi-Fi and network speed, the volume and output device, the battery with your Bluetooth devices' charge, and a System card with CPU, memory and the apps using the most.
author: Seb-GRAF

color.title: Ring color
color.description: The ring and the volume dots: a color such as #RRGGBB, or a theme color such as @token.accent.

chargingLight.title: Charging color, light mode
chargingLight.description: The ring while charging, and the ring in the Battery view.

lowBelow.title: Low battery at
lowBelow.description: The charge, from 0 to 1, at or below which the ring takes the low color. 0.2 is 20 %.

criticalBelow.title: Critical battery at
criticalBelow.description: The charge, from 0 to 1, at or below which the ring takes the critical color.

glyphSize.title: Ring size
glyphSize.description: The ring's diameter in points. Change the connection symbol's size with it.

ringGap.title: Ring opening
ringGap.description: Degrees left open at the bottom of the ring. 0 closes it.

volumeDots.title: Volume dots
volumeDots.description: How many dots show the volume, a whole number from 1. Three to five fit the ring.

flashAnimation.title: Volume change animation
flashAnimation.description: How the volume beside the ring changes while you adjust it.

signalBars.title: Wi-Fi signal bars
signalBars.description: How many bars show the Wi-Fi signal, a whole number from 1.

cpuWarning.title: Under load at CPU use
cpuWarning.description: The CPU use, from 0 to 1, that puts the load dot on the ring. Above 1 turns it off; memory pressure and heat still count.

memoryWarning.title: Under load at memory use
memoryWarning.description: The memory use, from 0 to 1, that puts the load dot on the ring. Above 1 turns it off.

processes.title: Apps to list
processes.description: How many apps the System view lists. Each app's helper processes count toward it.

sortBy.title: List the apps using the most
